meanings.en: the amount of rain that falls in a place
meanings.exampleEn: The region has heavy rainfall during the summer months.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgede yaz aylarında yoğun yağış olur.

meanings.en: a thick tropical forest with heavy rainfall
meanings.exampleEn: Many rare animals live in the Amazon rainforest.
meanings.exampleTr: Amazon yağmur ormanında birçok nadir hayvan yaşar.

meanings.en: a position in a system of levels or importance
meanings.exampleEn: She holds a high rank in the army.
meanings.exampleTr: Orduda yüksek bir rütbesi var.

meanings.en: happening or moving very quickly
meanings.exampleEn: The country experienced rapid economic growth.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke hızlı bir ekonomik büyüme yaşadı.

meanings.en: in a fast way; very quickly
meanings.exampleEn: Technology is changing rapidly these days.
meanings.exampleTr: Teknoloji bugünlerde hızla değişiyor.

meanings.en: not common; not happening often
meanings.exampleEn: This is a rare bird that few people have seen.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, az insanın gördüğü nadir bir kuştur.

meanings.en: not often; almost never
meanings.exampleEn: He rarely goes out on weekdays.
meanings.exampleTr: Hafta içi nadiren dışarı çıkar.

meanings.en: a small soft red fruit
meanings.exampleEn: She made a delicious cake with fresh raspberry.
meanings.exampleTr: Taze ahududu ile lezzetli bir kek yaptı.

meanings.en: a fixed amount of something allowed to one person
meanings.exampleEn: During the war, each family received a small ration of sugar.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş sırasında her aile az miktarda şeker tayını aldı.

meanings.en: based on reason rather than emotion
meanings.exampleEn: We need to make a rational decision about the budget.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütçe konusunda akılcı bir karar vermemiz gerekiyor.

meanings.en: a sharp tool used for shaving hair
meanings.exampleEn: He cut himself while shaving with an old razor.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski bir jiletle tıraş olurken kendini kesti.

meanings.en: the distance over which someone can stretch or extend
meanings.exampleEn: Keep the medicine out of the reach of children.
meanings.exampleTr: İlacı çocukların erişemeyeceği bir yerde tutun.

meanings.en: to behave in a particular way in response to something
meanings.exampleEn: How did she react when she heard the news?
meanings.exampleTr: Haberi duyunca nasıl tepki verdi?

meanings.en: sensible and practical; showing things as they really are
meanings.exampleEn: We should set realistic goals for this project.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu proje için gerçekçi hedefler belirlemeliyiz.

meanings.en: the true situation that actually exists
meanings.exampleEn: In reality, the job was much harder than it seemed.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerçekte iş göründüğünden çok daha zordu.

meanings.en: to arrange something again in a different way
meanings.exampleEn: We had to rearrange the furniture to fit the new sofa.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kanepeye yer açmak için mobilyaları yeniden düzenlemek zorunda kaldık.

meanings.en: fair and sensible; not too expensive
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel offers good service at a reasonable price.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel makul bir fiyata iyi hizmet sunuyor.

meanings.en: to build something again after it was damaged
meanings.exampleEn: They plan to rebuild the bridge that collapsed.
meanings.exampleTr: Çöken köprüyü yeniden inşa etmeyi planlıyorlar.

meanings.en: to remember something from the past
meanings.exampleEn: I can't recall her name right now.
meanings.exampleTr: Şu anda onun adını hatırlayamıyorum.

meanings.en: the area where guests are welcomed in a hotel or office
meanings.exampleEn: Please leave your keys at the reception.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen anahtarlarınızı resepsiyona bırakın.

meanings.en: to say a poem or piece of text aloud from memory
meanings.exampleEn: The children had to recite a poem in class.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar sınıfta bir şiiri ezbere okumak zorundaydı.

meanings.en: to get something back that was lost or taken
meanings.exampleEn: You can reclaim your lost luggage at the airport office.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaybolan bavulunuzu havaalanı ofisinden geri alabilirsiniz.

meanings.en: to know someone or something because you have seen it before
meanings.exampleEn: I didn't recognize you with your new haircut.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni saç kesiminle seni tanıyamadım.

meanings.en: to suggest that something is good or suitable
meanings.exampleEn: Can you recommend a good restaurant near here?
meanings.exampleTr: Buraya yakın iyi bir restoran tavsiye edebilir misin?

meanings.en: information stored in writing or the best ever achievement
meanings.exampleEn: She set a new world record in swimming.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüzmede yeni bir dünya rekoru kırdı.

meanings.en: sound or pictures that have been stored to listen to or watch later
meanings.exampleEn: They listened to a recording of the concert.
meanings.exampleTr: Konserin bir kaydını dinlediler.

meanings.en: to become healthy or normal again after an illness or problem
meanings.exampleEn: It took him weeks to recover from the flu.
meanings.exampleTr: Gripten iyileşmesi haftalar sürdü.

meanings.en: made from used materials that have been treated for reuse
meanings.exampleEn: This notebook is made from recycled paper.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu defter geri dönüştürülmüş kağıttan yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: the process of treating used materials so they can be used again
meanings.exampleEn: Recycling helps to reduce waste and protect the environment.
meanings.exampleTr: Geri dönüşüm atığı azaltmaya ve çevreyi korumaya yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: to make something smaller in size or amount
meanings.exampleEn: We must reduce the amount of plastic we use.
meanings.exampleTr: Kullandığımız plastik miktarını azaltmalıyız.

meanings.en: the act of making something smaller or less
meanings.exampleEn: There was a big reduction in prices during the sale.
meanings.exampleTr: İndirim sırasında fiyatlarda büyük bir azalma oldu.

meanings.en: a line of rocks or coral near the surface of the sea
meanings.exampleEn: Divers came to explore the colourful coral reef.
meanings.exampleTr: Dalgıçlar renkli mercan resifini keşfetmeye geldi.

meanings.en: a person who controls a sports match and applies the rules
meanings.exampleEn: The referee gave the player a red card.
meanings.exampleTr: Hakem oyuncuya kırmızı kart gösterdi.

meanings.en: an image seen in a mirror or shiny surface
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at her reflection in the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Camdaki yansımasına baktı.

meanings.en: small amounts of food and drink served at an event
meanings.exampleEn: Refreshments will be served after the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan sonra ikram sunulacaktır.

meanings.en: the act of saying that you will not do or accept something
meanings.exampleEn: His refusal to apologize surprised everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Özür dilemeyi reddetmesi herkesi şaşırttı.

meanings.en: waste material that is thrown away
meanings.exampleEn: The refuse is collected every Monday morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Çöp her pazartesi sabahı toplanır.

meanings.en: to get something back that you had lost
meanings.exampleEn: After the accident, she slowly began to regain her strength.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazadan sonra yavaş yavaş gücünü yeniden kazanmaya başladı.

meanings.en: a large area of land or part of a country
meanings.exampleEn: This region is famous for its wine.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bölge şarabıyla ünlüdür.

meanings.en: relating to a particular region or area
meanings.exampleEn: The festival celebrates regional food and music.
meanings.exampleTr: Festival bölgesel yemekleri ve müziği kutluyor.

meanings.en: an official list or record of names or items
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher checked the names in the register.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen kayıt defterindeki isimleri kontrol etti.

meanings.en: the act of putting your name on an official list
meanings.exampleEn: Registration for the course starts next week.
meanings.exampleTr: Kursa kayıt gelecek hafta başlıyor.

meanings.en: an official rule that controls how something is done
meanings.exampleEn: New safety regulations were introduced last year.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen yıl yeni güvenlik düzenlemeleri getirildi.

meanings.en: to refuse to accept or agree to something
meanings.exampleEn: The committee decided to reject his proposal.
meanings.exampleTr: Komite onun teklifini reddetmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: to show or have a connection between things
meanings.exampleEn: These two problems relate to each other.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu iki sorun birbiriyle ilişkilidir.

meanings.en: a connection between people or things
meanings.exampleEn: There is a close relation between diet and health.
meanings.exampleTr: Beslenme ile sağlık arasında yakın bir ilişki vardır.

meanings.en: the way in which people or things are connected
meanings.exampleEn: They have a strong relationship built on trust.
meanings.exampleTr: Güven üzerine kurulu güçlü bir ilişkileri var.

meanings.en: considered in comparison with something else
meanings.exampleEn: They live in relative comfort now.
meanings.exampleTr: Şimdi göreceli bir rahatlık içinde yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: to a certain degree, especially compared with others
meanings.exampleEn: The test was relatively easy for most students.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınav çoğu öğrenci için nispeten kolaydı.

meanings.en: making you feel calm and rested
meanings.exampleEn: A warm bath is very relaxing after a long day.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun bir günün ardından sıcak bir banyo çok rahatlatıcıdır.

meanings.en: a belief in and worship of a god or gods
meanings.exampleEn: People of every religion live peacefully in this city.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu şehirde her dinden insan barış içinde yaşar.

meanings.en: relating to religion or strongly believing in a religion
meanings.exampleEn: They held a religious ceremony at the temple.
meanings.exampleTr: Tapınakta dini bir tören düzenlediler.

meanings.en: to depend on or trust someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: You can rely on her to finish the job.
meanings.exampleTr: İşi bitirmesi için ona güvenebilirsin.

meanings.en: the part of something that is left after the rest is gone
meanings.exampleEn: We spent the remainder of the day at the beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Günün geri kalanını sahilde geçirdik.

meanings.en: unusual or special in a way that surprises you
meanings.exampleEn: She made a remarkable recovery after the surgery.
meanings.exampleTr: Ameliyattan sonra olağanüstü bir iyileşme gösterdi.

meanings.en: something that cures an illness or solves a problem
meanings.exampleEn: Honey is a good remedy for a sore throat.
meanings.exampleTr: Bal, boğaz ağrısı için iyi bir çaredir.

meanings.en: the act of remembering and honouring someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: A statue was built in remembrance of the soldiers.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerlerin anısına bir heykel dikildi.

meanings.en: a device used to control a machine from a distance
meanings.exampleEn: He used the remote control to change the channel.
meanings.exampleTr: Kanalı değiştirmek için uzaktan kumandayı kullandı.

meanings.en: to take something away from a place
meanings.exampleEn: Please remove your shoes before entering.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen girmeden önce ayakkabılarınızı çıkarın.

meanings.en: to make something valid again for a further period
meanings.exampleEn: I need to renew my passport before the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyahatten önce pasaportumu yenilemem gerekiyor.

meanings.en: to pay back money that you owe
meanings.exampleEn: He promised to repay the loan within a year.
meanings.exampleTr: Krediyi bir yıl içinde geri ödeyeceğine söz verdi.

meanings.en: many times; again and again
meanings.exampleEn: She repeatedly asked for help but no one listened.
meanings.exampleTr: Defalarca yardım istedi ama kimse dinlemedi.

meanings.en: a person who acts or speaks for a group or company
meanings.exampleEn: A sales representative will call you tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir satış temsilcisi yarın sizi arayacak.

meanings.en: to produce young, or to make a copy of something
meanings.exampleEn: Many fish reproduce by laying eggs.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok balık yumurta bırakarak ürer.

meanings.en: a country governed by elected representatives and a president
meanings.exampleEn: France has been a republic for over two hundred years.
meanings.exampleTr: Fransa iki yüz yıldan fazla süredir bir cumhuriyettir.

meanings.en: to need something or make it necessary
meanings.exampleEn: This job requires a lot of patience.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu iş çok sabır gerektirir.

meanings.en: something that is needed or demanded
meanings.exampleEn: A university degree is a requirement for this position.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu pozisyon için üniversite diploması bir şarttır.

meanings.en: the act of saving someone from danger
meanings.exampleEn: The rescue of the trapped miners took several days.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahsur kalan madencilerin kurtarılması birkaç gün sürdü.

meanings.en: a person who studies a subject carefully to find out new facts
meanings.exampleEn: The researcher published her findings in a journal.
meanings.exampleTr: Araştırmacı bulgularını bir dergide yayımladı.

meanings.en: to look like or be similar to someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She closely resembles her mother.
meanings.exampleTr: Annesine çok benziyor.
